judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — [P1, confidence 100] `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` reports a second page for every group whose membership count is exactly a multiple of the page limit, so admins navigate to an empty members page instead of seeing the complete membership list.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the totalPages calculation. When user_count is exactly divisible by limit (e.g., 50 users with limit 50), Math.floor(50/50) + 1 = 2, suggesting there are 2 pages when there's actually only 1 page of results. This would cause the admin to see a 'next' button that leads to an empty page. The correct formula should be Math.ceil(user_count / limit) or handle the exact division case differently.
